lines.text: Every year you skip your TFSA, you lose R46,000 of tax-free space. Forever.
SARS says any unused part of the yearly limit is forfeited. It does not carry over.
Put in R10,000 this tax year, and the other R36,000 of space disappears on the first of March.
Next year, you can't catch up. You only get next year's limit.
The R500,000 lifetime limit stays, but you fill it one year at a time.
At today's limit, that takes about eleven years. Every year you skip adds one more.
This tax year ends on the last day of February. That's your deadline.
Just don't go over R46,000 in total, or SARS charges a 40% penalty on the extra.
The full TFSA guide is on the channel. Follow for a new money rule every day.
Because the space you skip this year never comes back.
